programme.desc: Was Presidential hopeful, Robert F. Kennedy really killed by disgruntled Palestinian Sirhan Sirhan as we’ve been led to believe? Or was he another in a long line of Manchurian candidates, a victim of a long standing mind control program.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Past Life Regression Pt. 2
programme.desc: Richard witnesses a municipal employee in Toronto, Canada undergo a regression during which he re-experiences a previous life as a doctor in early 20 century England.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Bible Codes
programme.desc: Does the Bible contain hidden messages encoded within certain passages of the Old Testament? Is the prophetic nature of these 'codes' proof the Bible's author is of supernatural or extraterrestrial origin?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: Richard interviews the expedition organizer who is planning on leading a team of scientists, filmmakers and tourists to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard meets members of the 9/11 Truth movement who challenge the official version of events concerning the attack on the U.S. Pentagon. Researchers present evidence to suggest the attack was perpetrated by some rogue element inside the U.S. government.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Osama Bin Laden
programme.desc: Richard investigates claims that the supposed mastermind behind the 9/11 terrorist attacks and leader of the Al Qaeda terrorist cell remained a CIA asset until his death.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Dangers of EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequencies)
programme.desc: Can radiation from electrical appliances, power lines, microwave ovens, and wireless technology such as cell phones, baby monitors, alter our DNA, and cause illnesses?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Alien Abductions
programme.desc: Richard speaks with two alleged alien abductees about their claims they were taken aboard an alien space craft.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Council pt. 1
programme.desc: Jim Phelps leads the IMF on an assignment to destroy the syndicate, a criminal empire headed by Frank Wayne.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Council pt. 2
programme.desc: The IMF continues its fight against organized crime.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Astrologer

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Hazard
programme.desc: The victim had ingested a massive amount of cyanide. An unlikely clue ? a flaw on a mailing envelope ? exposed a murderer who was willing to kill innocent people.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shell Game
programme.desc: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ring Him Up
programme.desc: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. Her disappearance remained a mystery for ten years, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Impression
programme.desc: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband had killed Crystal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As the Tide Turns
programme.desc: The woman was dead. The man had been shot four times and survived. When the man's version of events contradicted physical evidence, investigators turned to forensic science to paint a clearer picture of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lady in Red
programme.desc: A woman in red drops a dying man off at a firehouse… and then vanishes. Identifying the mystery woman is the hurdle Kenda must overcome in order to bring him justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Stuck In A Coffin
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a five-alarm fire, first responders discover a lifeless body. When Kenda learns that the deadly blaze was no accident, he launches a manhunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: A park ranger discovers the corpse of amateur boxer Corey Edge floating in a shallow creek. Kenda learns the victim had ties to the criminal underworld, and investigates a rogue’s gallery of hustlers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: River of Blood
programme.desc: Two hunters discover a blood-drenched car, its owner riddled with buckshot. Lt. Joe Kenda learns the car was reported stolen the day before, he follows its trail to a group of unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: End of Days
programme.desc: The discovery of a family home littered with corpses tasks Kenda with unspooling the paranoid obsessions of a diseased mind, and forces him to confront his greatest fear.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia: Robert Farquharson
programme.desc: To get revenge on his ex-wife, Robert Farquharson kills his three sons by driving his car off a dam.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia: Peter Falconio
programme.desc: After stopping to help a man who flagged down their car, tourists Peter Falconio and Joanne Lees are attacked. Joanne managed to escape, but Peter's body was never found.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia
programme.desc: In one of Australia's most shocking gun crimes, Wade Frankum opens fire on unsuspecting shoppers in a Sydney mall.

programme.desc: Carly får at vide, at hun får mulighed for at få et fuldt stipendium til en privat eliteskole pga. netshowet. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i tvivl, men Sam og Freddie ved, at de må få hende til at gå efter det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fægtemesteren
programme.desc: Freddie trænger til lidt mandetid, så han slår sig sammen med Spencer for at træne fægtning. Freddie er et naturtalent, men tingene bliver indviklede, når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mod den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: En date til mig!
programme.desc: Når deres ven Gibby er for genert til at invitere en pige ud, som han kan lide, bestemmer vennerne sig for at få ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" indslag på deres netvideoshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så ham først!

programme.title: iCarly: Træk i nødbremsen
programme.desc: Carly må træde til, når Spencer bliver afhængig af et videospil. Sam snører Freddie til at tro, at han bliver forfulgt af uheld, når han nægter at sende et kædebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: I dyb gæld
programme.desc: Sam bliver fornærmet, når Freddie beskylder hende for ikke at betale ham og Carly nogle af de penge tilbage, som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver ihærdigt at betale dem tilbage - hun finder ligefrem et job.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts uheldige dag
programme.desc: En 'Dril Lewbert'-sketch går helt skævt og skader Carlys irriterende dørmand. Slænget plejer ham, indtil Freddies mor tager over. Men da kærligheden begynder at blomstre, må de sætte en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Tærtemysteriet
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Spencer tager Freddie med til deres yndlingskonditori, finder de ud af, at forpagteren er død. Men endnu værre er, hans opskrifter er måske gået tabt for evigt.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang kommer det desværre virkelig til at handle om alle dem der IKKE hjælper. Vi kører i S-tog med en mand med sennep og ketchup i hele masken og vælter flere gange en helt tårn med toiletpapir ned i hoved på en ung pige OG ingen hjælper…

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi sminker Pelle 80 år gammel og lader den gamle mand tabe bukserne foran en masse måbende cafegæster. Samtidig overrasker en rimelig ordinær video med en kvinde, der skal ind i et tog med en barnevogn – den går nemlig viralt!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi forsætter med de voldsomme videoer, når vi sammen med DBU og Salling Group sætter fokus på de grimme tilråb forældre har, når deres små poder spiller bold. Hør blandt andet, hvorfor vi vælger at tage de værste tilråb først.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst bliver ødelagt, da hendes mor kritiserer hendes plastikoperation. Kristin og pigerne tagr til Miami til Super Bowl-weekend, men stemningen bliver dårlig, da hun fester så hårdt, at det bekymrer Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Da rygterne går om Kristins partying får Stephanie skylden. Audrina begynder at date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra at prøve at score hende. Spencer bliver vred, da han møder Stephanie til Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for sin nabo, men den bliver overskygget af at Spencer flipper ud på Holly. Kristin opfordrer Audrina til at fokusere på Ryan, og prøver derefter at få et tættere forhold til Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers opførsel fører til, at deres venner og familie træffer et vanskeligt valg. Kristin og Brody kysser, men er enige om at fortsætte som singler. Ryan skuffer Audrina, da han ikke dukker op til en bytur.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody sætter sit venskab med Kristin på spil da han begynder at date en anden pige. Lo sender Stephanie ud på en dobbeldate. Ryan giver Audrinas venner en ny chance.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin slider med at komme videre efter Brody. Audrina møder Justin og begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Ryan. Lo bliver venner med Brodys nye kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme lægger sig ud med Kristin da hun tager en af Kristins rivalr med til en fest. Ryan kommer tilbage fra turneen, men Audrina forteæler ham ikke, at hun mødtes med Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan bliver sat på prøve, da han møder Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side da Allie skændes med hende. Stephanie har en skuffende anden date.

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Lige da Audrina afslutter tingene med Ryan, overrasker Justin hende på hendes fødselsdag. McKaelas ven Allie skaber flere problemer for Kristin. Brody fortæller Justin hvad han tænker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfertur til Costa Rica gør Kristin Brody jaloux ved at kysse med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver at modstå den tiltrækning, hun føler til Justin, og Stephanie har det svæt i junglen.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Mob Wife Goes In

programme.desc: Gaby ejer intet andet end sin yogamåtte og en 1972 Land Cruiser, som hun købte af sin eks for 200 dollar. Drengene begynder med det ydre...

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Farrah er en populær leder af heppekoret fra Council Bluffs i Iowa, men da hendes venner begynder at sladre om, at hun skal være alenemor, opgiver hun interessen for high school og begynder at tilbringe alt for meget tid med sin kommanderende mor.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Amber er en partypige fra Anderson, Indiana. Hun havde aldrig forestillet sig, at hun skulle tilbringe sit sidste skoleår med at flytte ind hos sin velmenende, men umodne kæreste Gary.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: A New Family
programme.desc: Sommeren på Jersey Shore bliver sparket igang da otte meget forskellige fremmede flytter ind i deres fælles hus ved stranden. Romancerne blusser straks op da de mødes og Sammy og Mike er de første til at knytte bånd på Jersey Shore.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Tanned Triangle
programme.desc: Snooki mener stadigvæk at alle hader hende, så hun beslutter sig for at forlade Jersey Shore. På den første bytur går vores nye kammerater i serien til den, så kæresterne derhjemme får en del at bekymre sig om.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Good Riddance
programme.desc: Kærligheds-trekanten bliver endnu mere intens da Ronnie fanger Sammy i at give sit nummer til en helt fjerde fyr. En af deltagerne vælger at forlade Jersey Shore for altid.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 402
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blindes eksperter kommer på arbejde i Hørning, hvor præsten og hendes familie bor til leje i et rækkehus og gerne vil videre – men bliver skræmte af tilstandsrapporter og spidse tage.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om at skifte deres 60 kvm lejebolig på Nørrebro ud med en murermestervilla i Hillerød. Men de fortryder bittert, at de lod eksperterne hjælpe, da de ser det hus, pengene rakte til.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små børn – og en drøm om at flytte sammen med bedsteforældrene. Så eksperterne skal på jagt efter et hus, der kan rumme to familier, med plads til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke plads nok i den lille Frederiksberg-lejlighed efter familieforøgning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er tårnhøje, så selv med 7 millioner til køb, kan de ikke finde det rigtige.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 703
programme.desc: Caféen i Aalborg kører slet ikke rundt. En forretning udelukkende baseret på billige deal-gæster, truer med at slå bunden ud af det unge forpagter-pars økonomi.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 704
programme.desc: På Da Carmine har de en vaskeægte napolitansk kok! Men problemet er bare, at han har mistet passionen for at lave ægte italiensk mad.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 705
programme.desc: I de smukkeste omgivelser i Korsør lystskov ligger restaurant Sommerlyst. Stedet er drevet af Jesper og Yvonne, der 4 måneder inde i deres forpagtning, allerede er ved at kaste håndklædet i ringen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 706
programme.desc: Restaurant Limone drives af ægteparret Johnny og Helle. Restauranten, der ligger inde i en biograf, kæmper med at få gæster til at komme og spise - og ikke bare gå i biografen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 501
programme.desc: På Gesten Kro er forpagteren Tim på 34 år magtesløs. Aften efter aften står restauranten tom, og når der endelig kommer gæster, bliver de ikke længere end højest nødvendigt.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Hangover

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Creepin'
programme.desc: Angelina må sluge sin stolthed og sige undskyld til pigerne. I huset hygger The Situation, Vinny og Pauly D sig i boblebadet, mens Ronnie fortsætter med at krybe bag Sammi ryg.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Breaking Up
programme.desc: Ronnies dårlige opførsel sætter Snooki, Angelina og JWOWW i en svær situation. Pigerne bliver sammen enige om at skrive et anonymt brev til Sammi, for en gang for alle at afsløre hele sandheden om Ronnie for hende.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Letter
programme.desc: Sammi finder Snooki og JWOWWs 'anonyme' brev, og denne gang er det for alvor slut mellem Ronnie og hende - i hvert fald indtil videre. I mellemtiden har Mike, Vinny og Pauly deres hænder fulde, da de har gang i fire piger på en aften.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Not So Shore
programme.desc: Det anonyme brev skaber splid mellem pigerne og det kulminerer naturligvis og ender i et klassisk Jersey Shore-slagsmål. Samtidig opdager Snooki en lille hemmelighed om Vinny.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sleeping with the Enemy
programme.desc: Stemningen i huset er yderst trykket efter pigernes infight og et meget overraskende hook-up chokerer crewet.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: An Emotional Ending
programme.desc: Det er ved at være slut i Geordie Shore-huset og nogle er mere ivrige efter at rejse end andre, men før de pakker er der tid til at feste på Geordie-maner og kærlige følelser flyder igen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Amsterdam Welcomes The Geordies
programme.desc: Geordie Shore-slænget er flyttet ind i deres nye hus og er klar til at lave mere balede. Anna overrasker familien med en rejse til Amsterdam, som flere af dem hellere vil glemme.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: You Will Get Punished Dan

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: With Friends Like This
programme.desc: A young man is found gunned down outside his home. Sgt. Joe Kenda and Det. John Anderson must determine whether the killer was a complete stranger, a barrio gang member, or a jealous lover.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trust No One
programme.desc: When martial arts enthusiast Carl Hunt suffers a fatal knife wound to the gut, his friends and neighbors offer few viable leads. But Kenda discovers blood evidence that proves he’s being lied to.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
programme.desc: In his first year on the force, rookie patrol officer Joe Kenda quickly learns the ropes. But when he tries to singlehandedly stop a brawling mob, he finds himself facing down gunfire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Written in Blood
programme.desc: A community is shocked when Antoine McKenzie is brazenly shot outside an auto parts store in broad daylight. The only lead left for Lt. Joe Kenda is a final message written in the victim’s own blood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.desc: I et forsøg på at pifte julen op med et utraditionelt træ, kommer Spencer til at sætte ild til alle Carlys gaver. Fortvivlet ønsker hun, at hun havde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Det første kys
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortælle Carly, at han aldrig har kysset en pige, og afslører hans hemmelighed på netshowet. Gibby og Carly træner Spencer til udtagelser for det lokale professionelle fodboldhold.

programme.title: iCarly: Hvem vil have en bil?
programme.desc: Slænget kører en konkurrence på iCarly, og præmien er en ny til fra en lokal forhandler. Da Nevel vinder, opdager børnene, at forhandleren ikke kendte noget til konkurrencen eller bilen, de skulle give væk.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg møder Fred
programme.desc: Freddie siger offentligt, at han ikke er en fan af internetsensationen Fred, og får Fred til at meddele, at han holder op med at lave sine videoer. Hans fans bliver rasende over, at Freddie fik stoppet de populære videoer.

programme.title: iCarly: Et perfekt match
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniger sig ud for at tage til en MMA-kamp, får de deres dobbeltgængere til at snøre Spencer til at tro, at de stadig er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kæmpe version af Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi valgte vinderen
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie opfordrer iCarly-fans til at stemme på David Archuleta i Amerika Synger, får de ondt af nummer to og hjælper ham med at lave en musikvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: En sødere Sam
programme.desc: Da Sam indrømmer, at hun kan lide en dreng i skolen, lærer Carly hende, hvordan hun besnærer ham ved at opføre sig mere piget. Spencer er overbevist om, at en pige kan lide ham pga. hans smoking, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 1
programme.desc: Da Carly dater er en hård negl, prøver hun at holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for at bygge en hjemmeside med alle hendes klamme video-favoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Normalt hylder vi folk, der reagerer på vores små set ups rundt omkring, men her hylder vi folk, der til dagligt gør gode gerninger – og vi tager hyldesterne til nye højder, så vildt at en af dem kalder det ”SVINERI”!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi ved godt, at det er tarveligt at bruge små søde børn, der har brug for hjælp. Det er nemlig et billigt trick, MEN det virker. Og en ting er, at set up’et er sødt, men ham der hjælpers reaktion er virkelig også skøn – det er jul, når det er bedst!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Det tog Malte Ebert cirka 2 sekunder at overveje, om han ville være med i en video, hvor vi hylder skønne, hjælpsomme Cecilie, der elsker Malte. Kom bag om videoen, hvor vi sammen med Malte og 100 andre tager fusen på Cecilie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En ellers lidt ordinær video EKSPLODEREDE på Tik Tok, da en mand der hjalp sagde nej til Pelles blomster med ordene ”Nej tak, jeg er til kvinder – helst!”. Vi taler om, hvad der har overrasket os i forhold til hvilke videoer der når langt ud.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Et par har en hed og lang nat sammen. Og så venter sæsonens første Parceremoni, hvor flere er i fare for at ryge hjem. Og der kæmpes til det sidste, for ingen vil være de første, der sendes hjem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Der er godt gang i festen, hvor der snaves igennem på dansegulvet. Alt ændrer sig, da en tjener kommer ind med to kister, for nu skal to piger kæmpe for ikke at komme i fare.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 3105

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 312

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Pelle og René sætter ord på tilblivelsen af ”Den Gode Gerning”. Hør hvordan René nærmest ved et tilfælde bliver revet med i foretagendet, og så står de med en vild opdagelse efter, de har optaget de første videoer – det er kun de ”gamle” der hjælper!!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En af de bedste gerninger, man kan gøre, er at sige noget pænt til en fremmed. Det er vi ikke så gode til her i landet, derfor lader vi selvfølgelig en mand gøre det. Det er SÅ fedt, dejligt og tankevækkende at se folks reaktioner på de søde ord.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang fortæller vi blandt andet om den nok mest populære video, vi har lavet – en video med Lukas Graham, der overrasker en hjælpsom fan, 10-årige Felix. Felix er SÅ sødt og hans reaktion trækker tårer hos alle der ser videoen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi kommer omkring nogle klassiske videoer, og så prøver vi noget nyt. Vi får en bager til at give en gratis brunsviger til dem, der vælger at sætte musik på og danse i butikken – det er det sjoveste vi har lavet!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.desc: Sydney afpresser Michael med et svindelnummer, hvor hun flytter ind hos ham og kalder sig hans nye kæreste.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Chinese Box
programme.desc: David holdes som gidsel i en elevator i FBI-bygningen og Don bliver ved med at feje Charlies forslag til redningen af David af bordet, mens der planlægges et alt eller intet angreb.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Breaking Point
programme.desc: Charlies liv kommer i fare, efter han er blevet interviewet om en sag han og Don arbejder på. Interviewet tiltrækker opmærksom hos en opsøgende journalists kidnappere.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Power
programme.desc: Dons hold kommer på sporet af en serie-voldtægtsmand, som misbruger sit job som politimand til at få fat i sine ofre.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Black Swan
programme.desc: En razzia mod en narko-laboratorium giver en overraskende anholdelse, der får holdet til at få i stå, mens de prøver at regne ud hvorfor han er i det område. Megan er dybt uenig i den metode Don vælger til at fremskaffe svar.

programme.title: NCIS: Venner og elskende
programme.desc: NCIS samarbejder med de lokale myndigheder, da de mistænker, at en matros døde af en utilsigtet overdosis i en lurvet del af byen.

programme.title: NCIS: Talte dage
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet samarbejder med en inspektør fra det internationale agentur for atomenergi, der bliver udsat for stråling. De rekonstruerer hans færden i forsøg på at finde ud af, hvor strålingen fandt sted.

programme.title: NCIS: Skeletter
programme.desc: Da Ducky og Abby identificerer mindst fem lig, begynder NCIS-teamet straks at underrette familierne i forsøg på at finde forbindelsen mellem de tilsyneladende tilfældige ofre.

programme.title: NCIS: Lagt på is
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker en sag, hvor en marinesoldat, der tilsyneladende frøs til døde, vågner op på Duckys obduktionsbord.

programme.title: NCIS: Respit
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet efterforsker en sag, hvor et weekendopkald til NCIS's tiplinje resulterer i to agenters død. NCIS-teamet opdager, at tippet om terroristaktivitet var en fælde, som resulterede i de to agenters død.

programme.title: NCIS: Dækhistorie
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet efterforsker en sag, hvor McGees roman om en NCIS-agent bliver til virkelighed. McGee bliver forfærdet, da en underofficer, som han baserede sin karakter på i sin seneste bog, bliver myrdet.

programme.title: Scorpion DA: The Hole Truth

programme.title: 2900 Happiness

programme.title: 2900 Happiness

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I sæsonpremieren af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Kim Vilforts 12 år i Brøndby IF – fra præsentationen i 1986 til den sidste kamp i 1998. Hør om de største kampe, titlerne og øjeblikkene, der gjorde ham til en af klubbens største profiler.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' følger du Henrik Heggheims rejse fra Stavanger til Brøndby IF. Hør om overgangen til dansk fodbold, tilværelsen på Vestegnen og de oplevelser, der har formet ham som spiller og menneske i den gule trøje.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' møder du de nye forsvarsspillere Rasmus Lauritsen og Frederik Winther, hører Thomas Mikkelsen sætte ord på rollen som erfaren sidste skanse – og følger Joe Bells rejse og refleksioner i Brøndby-trøjen.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Frederik Alves om at gribe chancen, Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer sin milepæl med 50 kampe i gult og blåt, og Rasmus Lauritsen ser tilbage på sin startdebut i Brøndby IF-trøjen.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Ole Bjur sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I første episode får Ibi Støving, Daniel Wass, Søren Colding og Dan Anton Johansen besøg af John “Faxe” Jensen til en snak om Brøndbys historie – og slutter med at sætte deres bedste Brøndby 5-a-side nogensinde.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' gælder det EAFC 24 og det evige rivalopgør. Spillerne tester hinanden i 'Gæt en spiller' og dyster i en intens Derby Special, hvor både viden og håneret er på spil – og hvor konkurrencen når nye højder.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles DA

programme.title: Winners and Sinners DA

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Joes besidderiske adfærd er dagens samtaleemne - og ikke den eneste advarselslampe. Rygter om, at han har en kæreste derhjemme, kommer også frem i lyset.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 5

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 6

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Dramaet fortsætter for vores All Stars, mens parrene prøver at finde kærligheden. Den internationale superstjerne Jason Derulo optræder i villaen, og deltagerne står over for en vigtig beslutning.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Efter Danielles beslutning er konsekvenserne tydelige, og Ekin-Su er rasende over, at Curtis ikke fik lukket den med Danielle.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Det er tid til pardannelse, og Curtis træffer et valg, der chokerer både Ekin-Su og de andre Islandere.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 612

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Invisible Hand of Death
programme.desc: Two teens stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder just who in her inner circle could kill so cruelly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Secret Life
programme.desc: After Lourdes Riddle is found strangled to death in the trunk of her car, homicide detective Joe Kenda follows the trail through a twisting maze of military and cultural secrets.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Confession
programme.desc: After a husband and wife are viciously attacked in their own home, Kenda is on the hunt for a troubled teen whose appetite for violence knows no bounds.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Preying on the Innocent

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My, My, Merry Christmas

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Run for your Life

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling

programme.desc: Deputies pursue a man involved in a carjacking. Deputies are called to an altercation between a father and son. Officers respond to an unresponsive woman lying in a roadway.

programme.title: COPS: Mamma's House
programme.desc: Deputies search for a man who ran from a traffic stop. A man being pursued tells officers he was going to his mother's house. A drunk driver won't admit to hitting a car.
